name: git-gremlin
description: Scoped commits, draft PRs, and full PR completion through native review, corrections, CI, and protected merge for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Commit, publish draft PRs, and finish authorized PR delivery
interface.longDescription: Git Gremlin drafts commits and PRs from Git context, preserves scoped mutation authority, and completes existing PRs through native review, supported fixes, local checks, review comments, CI, and protected merge. It reuses existing PRs on resume, keeps replies behind published fixes, and confirms actual merge before reporting completion.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Gremlin to commit my changes.
Use Git Gremlin to open a GitHub PR for this branch.
Use Git Gremlin to handle the review comments on this PR.
Use Git Gremlin to finish this PR through review, corrections, CI, and merge.
